name: iMessage
description: Talk to her in Messages through BlueBubbles on your own Mac.
author: The Sara team

settings.label: BlueBubbles address
settings.tip: Where BlueBubbles runs, with its port. 127.0.0.1:1234 if Sara runs on the same Mac; otherwise the Mac's address on your home network or its Tailscale name, like 192.168.1.20:1234.

settings.label: BlueBubbles runs on another computer on my network
settings.tip: Lets Sara talk to BlueBubbles on another computer at home or on your Tailscale network. Never anything on the internet.

settings.label: BlueBubbles server password
settings.tip: The password you saved in BlueBubbles' Connection step. Kept encrypted in Sara's vault. Anyone with it can read and send her messages.

settings.label: Send read receipts (Private API only)
settings.tip: Shows 'Read' under your messages when she has them. Only works if BlueBubbles' Private API is on.

settings.label: Send reminders and messages she starts to my iMessage too
settings.tip: Her reminders and messages she starts also come to Messages on your iPhone. Only to you.

settings.label: Check for messages every (seconds, when not woken)
settings.tip: Only used when BlueBubbles can't ring Sara. Lower is faster but asks the Mac more often.

settings.label: BlueBubbles uses HTTPS
settings.tip: Turn on only if you gave BlueBubbles a certificate for the address above. Without it the password travels unencrypted on your home network; Tailscale or the same Mac avoids that.

es.Talk to her in Messages through BlueBubb: Habla con ella en Mensajes a través de BlueBubbles en tu propio Mac.
es.Where BlueBubbles runs, with its port. 1: Dónde funciona BlueBubbles, con su puerto. 127.0.0.1:1234 si Sara funciona en el mismo Mac; si no, la dirección del Mac en tu red de casa o su nombre de Tailscale, como 192.168.1.20:1234.
es.BlueBubbles runs on another computer on: BlueBubbles funciona en otro ordenador de mi red
es.Lets Sara talk to BlueBubbles on another: Deja que Sara hable con BlueBubbles en otro ordenador de tu casa o de tu red de Tailscale. Nunca nada en internet.
es.The password you saved in BlueBubbles' C: La contraseña que guardaste en el paso Connection de BlueBubbles. Se guarda cifrada en la bóveda de Sara. Quien la tenga puede leer y enviar sus mensajes.
es.Send read receipts (Private API only): Enviar confirmaciones de lectura (solo con la Private API)
es.Shows 'Read' under your messages when sh: Muestra 'Leído' bajo tus mensajes cuando ella los tiene. Solo funciona si la Private API de BlueBubbles está activada.
es.Send reminders and messages she starts t: Enviar también a mi iMessage los recordatorios y mensajes que ella inicia
es.Her reminders and messages she starts al: Sus recordatorios y los mensajes que ella inicia también llegan a Mensajes en tu iPhone. Solo a ti.
es.Check for messages every (seconds, when: Buscar mensajes cada (segundos, si no la avisan)
es.Only used when BlueBubbles can't ring Sa: Solo se usa cuando BlueBubbles no puede avisar a Sara. Menos es más rápido, pero pregunta al Mac más a menudo.
es.Turn on only if you gave BlueBubbles a c: Actívalo solo si diste a BlueBubbles un certificado para la dirección de arriba. Sin él, la contraseña viaja sin cifrar por tu red de casa; Tailscale o el mismo Mac lo evitan.

fr.Talk to her in Messages through BlueBubb: Parlez-lui dans Messages grâce à BlueBubbles sur votre propre Mac.
fr.Where BlueBubbles runs, with its port. 1: Où tourne BlueBubbles, avec son port. 127.0.0.1:1234 si Sara tourne sur le même Mac ; sinon l'adresse du Mac sur votre réseau domestique ou son nom Tailscale, comme 192.168.1.20:1234.
fr.BlueBubbles runs on another computer on: BlueBubbles tourne sur un autre ordinateur de mon réseau
fr.Lets Sara talk to BlueBubbles on another: Permet à Sara de parler à BlueBubbles sur un autre ordinateur chez vous ou sur votre réseau Tailscale. Jamais rien sur internet.
fr.BlueBubbles server password: Mot de passe du serveur BlueBubbles
fr.The password you saved in BlueBubbles' C: Le mot de passe enregistré à l'étape Connection de BlueBubbles. Gardé chiffré dans le coffre de Sara. Qui l'a peut lire et envoyer ses messages.
fr.Send read receipts (Private API only): Envoyer des accusés de lecture (Private API seulement)
fr.Shows 'Read' under your messages when sh: Affiche « Lu » sous vos messages quand elle les a. Ne marche que si la Private API de BlueBubbles est activée.
fr.Send reminders and messages she starts t: Envoyer aussi sur mon iMessage les rappels et les messages qu'elle commence
fr.Her reminders and messages she starts al: Ses rappels et les messages qu'elle commence arrivent aussi dans Messages sur votre iPhone. Seulement à vous.
fr.Check for messages every (seconds, when: Chercher les messages toutes les (secondes, sans réveil)
fr.Only used when BlueBubbles can't ring Sa: Sert seulement quand BlueBubbles ne peut pas prévenir Sara. Plus bas est plus rapide mais interroge le Mac plus souvent.
fr.Turn on only if you gave BlueBubbles a c: À activer seulement si vous avez donné à BlueBubbles un certificat pour l'adresse ci-dessus. Sans lui, le mot de passe circule en clair sur votre réseau ; Tailscale ou le même Mac l'évitent.

de.Talk to her in Messages through BlueBubb: Sprich mit ihr in Nachrichten über BlueBubbles auf deinem eigenen Mac.
de.Where BlueBubbles runs, with its port. 1: Wo BlueBubbles läuft, mit Port. 127.0.0.1:1234, wenn Sara auf demselben Mac läuft; sonst die Adresse des Macs in deinem Heimnetz oder sein Tailscale-Name, etwa 192.168.1.20:1234.
de.BlueBubbles runs on another computer on: BlueBubbles läuft auf einem anderen Computer in meinem Netzwerk
de.Lets Sara talk to BlueBubbles on another: Lässt Sara mit BlueBubbles auf einem anderen Computer zu Hause oder in deinem Tailscale-Netz sprechen. Nie etwas im Internet.
de.The password you saved in BlueBubbles' C: Das Passwort, das du im Schritt Connection von BlueBubbles gespeichert hast. Verschlüsselt in Saras Tresor. Wer es hat, kann ihre Nachrichten lesen und senden.
de.Shows 'Read' under your messages when sh: Zeigt „Gelesen“ unter deinen Nachrichten, wenn sie sie hat. Geht nur, wenn die Private API von BlueBubbles an ist.
de.Send reminders and messages she starts t: Erinnerungen und Nachrichten, die sie beginnt, auch an mein iMessage senden
de.Her reminders and messages she starts al: Ihre Erinnerungen und Nachrichten, die sie beginnt, kommen auch in Nachrichten auf deinem iPhone an. Nur an dich.
de.Check for messages every (seconds, when: Nach Nachrichten sehen alle (Sekunden, ohne Weckruf)
de.Only used when BlueBubbles can't ring Sa: Nur, wenn BlueBubbles Sara nicht wecken kann. Weniger ist schneller, fragt den Mac aber öfter.
de.Turn on only if you gave BlueBubbles a c: Nur einschalten, wenn BlueBubbles ein Zertifikat für die Adresse oben hat. Ohne geht das Passwort unverschlüsselt durch dein Heimnetz; Tailscale oder derselbe Mac vermeiden das.

pt-BR.Talk to her in Messages through BlueBubb: Converse com ela no Mensagens pelo BlueBubbles no seu próprio Mac.
pt-BR.Where BlueBubbles runs, with its port. 1: Onde o BlueBubbles roda, com a porta. 127.0.0.1:1234 se a Sara roda no mesmo Mac; senão, o endereço do Mac na sua rede de casa ou o nome dele no Tailscale, como 192.168.1.20:1234.
pt-BR.BlueBubbles runs on another computer on: O BlueBubbles roda em outro computador da minha rede
pt-BR.Lets Sara talk to BlueBubbles on another: Deixa a Sara falar com o BlueBubbles em outro computador da sua casa ou da sua rede Tailscale. Nunca nada na internet.
pt-BR.The password you saved in BlueBubbles' C: A senha que você salvou na etapa Connection do BlueBubbles. Fica criptografada no cofre da Sara. Quem a tiver pode ler e enviar as mensagens dela.
pt-BR.Send read receipts (Private API only): Enviar confirmações de leitura (só com a Private API)
pt-BR.Shows 'Read' under your messages when sh: Mostra 'Lida' sob suas mensagens quando ela as recebe. Só funciona se a Private API do BlueBubbles estiver ligada.
pt-BR.Send reminders and messages she starts t: Enviar também ao meu iMessage os lembretes e mensagens que ela começa
pt-BR.Her reminders and messages she starts al: Os lembretes dela e as mensagens que ela começa também chegam ao Mensagens no seu iPhone. Só para você.
pt-BR.Check for messages every (seconds, when: Procurar mensagens a cada (segundos, sem aviso)
pt-BR.Only used when BlueBubbles can't ring Sa: Só é usado quando o BlueBubbles não consegue avisar a Sara. Menos é mais rápido, mas consulta o Mac com mais frequência.
pt-BR.Turn on only if you gave BlueBubbles a c: Ligue só se você deu ao BlueBubbles um certificado para o endereço acima. Sem ele, a senha viaja sem criptografia na sua rede de casa; Tailscale ou o mesmo Mac evitam isso.

it.Talk to her in Messages through BlueBubb: Parla con lei in Messaggi tramite BlueBubbles sul tuo Mac.
it.Where BlueBubbles runs, with its port. 1: Dove gira BlueBubbles, con la porta. 127.0.0.1:1234 se Sara gira sullo stesso Mac; altrimenti l'indirizzo del Mac sulla rete di casa o il suo nome Tailscale, come 192.168.1.20:1234.
it.BlueBubbles runs on another computer on: BlueBubbles gira su un altro computer della mia rete
it.Lets Sara talk to BlueBubbles on another: Permette a Sara di parlare con BlueBubbles su un altro computer di casa o sulla tua rete Tailscale. Mai nulla su internet.
it.The password you saved in BlueBubbles' C: La password salvata nel passo Connection di BlueBubbles. Custodita cifrata nella cassaforte di Sara. Chi ce l'ha può leggere e inviare i suoi messaggi.
it.Send read receipts (Private API only): Invia conferme di lettura (solo con la Private API)
it.Shows 'Read' under your messages when sh: Mostra 'Letto' sotto i tuoi messaggi quando li ha ricevuti. Funziona solo se la Private API di BlueBubbles è attiva.
it.Send reminders and messages she starts t: Invia anche al mio iMessage i promemoria e i messaggi che inizia lei
it.Her reminders and messages she starts al: I suoi promemoria e i messaggi che inizia arrivano anche in Messaggi sul tuo iPhone. Solo a te.
it.Check for messages every (seconds, when: Controlla i messaggi ogni (secondi, senza avviso)
it.Only used when BlueBubbles can't ring Sa: Usato solo quando BlueBubbles non riesce ad avvisare Sara. Meno è più veloce, ma interroga il Mac più spesso.
it.Turn on only if you gave BlueBubbles a c: Attivalo solo se hai dato a BlueBubbles un certificato per l'indirizzo sopra. Senza, la password viaggia in chiaro sulla rete di casa; Tailscale o lo stesso Mac lo evitano.
